label: S5 route frame entails S4 route frame (inference)
rule: Frame inclusion s5_implies_s4 of the modal library (a reflexive Euclidean relation is transitive)
meaning: Strength order registration: if the route's modal frame is reflexive and Euclidean (S5), it is reflexive and transitive (S4). Applies the existing modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.s5_implies_s4 to the route frame. Establishes neither frame premise.
